room_rent.note: If room taken at higher rate, all other hospital expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-payment on every admissible claim amount

sub_limits.display: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000/eye (lower); modern treatments: 50% of SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year; listed modern/advanced procedures capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Accidents exempt; not applicable if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Only PEDs declared and accepted by insurer are covered after 36 months

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24-month list includes cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, etc.; joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis have 48-month wait

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: 5% added per claim-free year; reduced at same rate if claim made; SI not reduced on claim

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy

day_care.display: Listed day-care procedures (383 listed in Annexure C)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to full sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern/advanced procedures (robotic surgery, stereotactic radiosurgery, oral chemo, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, consumables listed under non-payable items in Annexure A List I

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies separately to enhanced SI portions

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly instalment; 30 days for quarterly/half-yearly/annual and renewal

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewal or porting/migration

portability.note: Port to same product of other insurer; apply 45 days before but not earlier than 60 days before renewal

notable_exclusions: Domiciliary/OPD, maternity, sterility/IVF, obesity surgery (unless criteria met), refractive error <7.5D, treatment outside India, war/nuclear/bio/chemical
